summary: Verified logout availability/bug-fix criteria (header + sidebar sign-out reachable on desktop/mobile, working logout, no nav regression) via 5 browser checks. All passed, including one run against the public preview ingress URL.

checks.criterion: Sign out always reachable on desktop for every role (bug: 'Logout not available for users')
checks.name: logout-visible-desktop-multi-role
checks.evidence: Logged in as kumararaja (admin), bo2001 (backoffice), qaagent (agent) at 1366x640 and 1280x720; header-logout-button and sidebar logout-button both visible for all 6 combinations. Screenshots captured per role/viewport.

checks.name: logout-ends-session-redirects-login
checks.evidence: Clicked header-logout-button -> redirected to /login; visiting / afterwards redirected back to /login (401 on /api/me confirmed in console). Repeated for sidebar logout-button with same result.

checks.name: logout-visible-mobile-viewport
checks.evidence: At 390x844 logged in as qaagent; header-logout-button visible and clickable, mobile-nav icon row visible; clicking logout redirected to /login.

checks.name: sidebar-nav-and-search-no-regression
checks.evidence: At 1366x800 logged in as admin; global-policy-search-input visible, clicked nav-policies and URL changed to /policies.

checks.criterion: Sign out always reachable on desktop (public ingress cross-check)
checks.name: logout-preview-ingress-smoke
checks.evidence: Ran against https://insurance-mis-portal.preview.emergentagent.com at 1366x640 as admin; header-logout-button and sidebar logout-button visible, logout redirected to /login.
